# GripPointEditor

**Class** · namespace `VRFramework.Core.Editors.Interaction` · assembly `VRFramework.Core.Editors` · [view source](https://git.cie-group.cz/vr-framework/vrf4/core/-/blob/main/Editor/Interaction/GripPointEditor.cs#L21)

Inspector for [`GripPoint`](/api/vrframework-interaction-runtime/GripPoint), and the whole of authoring a hand pose.

Everything about how this object is held that is more than "pick it up" is here, on one
component, at the place it applies to. Add a grip point where the hand should land, say which
hand may take it and what its fingers do, and if that is Custom, pose the hand right here.

Two of these settings decide something invisible - which hand ends up where on a two-handed
object, and whether the fingers are solved or authored - and getting either the wrong way round
is silent at run time. So each says what it means where it is set, rather than in a document.

```csharp
[CustomEditor(typeof(GripPoint))]
[CanEditMultipleObjects]
public class GripPointEditor : VRFComponentEditor
```
